summary: This re-audit confirms the specific defect from the prior rejection is fixed: /site-materials is now in middleware.ts's PROTECTED_PREFIXES, so the new Site Materials page correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login instead of bypassing auth. The rest of the diff (new construction-materials/construction-budget/manpower-cost-report/schedule-tracker proxy routes, SiteMaterialsClient.tsx, site-materials page) is additive, isolated, and faithfully mirrors the existing requireAuth()+callVeridian(..., {root:true}) proxy pattern established by the pre-existing labour-roster route -- every new route checks ctx.response before proceeding and requireAuth() guarantees organizationId is non-null whenever it doesn't, so the ctx.organizationId! assertions are safe. No schema/migration/auth/RLS files are touched in this repo (the DB migration lives in the separate compliance-tracker PR, not this diff), consistent with tier1 classification. One real but low-blast-radius bug found: /api/schedule-tracker/import passes a FormData body into callVeridianRaw(), which unconditionally does JSON.stringify(options.body) and sets Content-Type: application/json -- this serializes to the literal string "{}", silently dropping the uploaded file rather than passing it through as multipart, contradicting the route's own comment. However this route has no live caller yet (PROGRESS.md's own Remaining section confirms the Schedule Tracker UI screen, which would call it, has not been built), so it ships as unreachable dead code with no current user-facing or security impact. Recommend approving this PR as-is and filing the import bug as a targeted follow-up before the Schedule Tracker UI ships.
issues: src/app/api/schedule-tracker/import/route.ts passes a FormData `body` into callVeridianRaw(), which JSON.stringify()s it and forces Content-Type: application/json, so the uploaded Excel file is never actually transmitted (VERIDIAN receives the literal string "{}" instead of multipart data). Not currently reachable from any shipped UI (Schedule Tracker screen is still unbuilt per PROGRESS.md), so no active impact, but must be fixed (either give callVeridianRaw a raw-body/no-JSON-encode mode, or have this route build its own fetch) before that UI ships.

PROGRESS.md documents this PR as an intentionally partial slice of a larger task -- Budget/Schedule/Manpower-report UI screens, sidebar nav entries, i18n keys, and route-level tests for the new proxy routes are explicitly deferred to follow-up work, not silently dropped. Flagging for visibility, not as a defect in what was actually shipped.
